title: Four Cakes by Half Past Two  (Quatro Bolos Até as Duas e Meia)

segments.t: Dez segundos depois, na acolhedora cozinha do café, Tessa e Owen picam amêndoas tranquilamente quando Hannah irrompe pela porta vaivém levantando três dedos. Ouçam primeiro a cena toda.
Emergency bulletin from the station desk: our mapmaker arrives at three sharp today!
Three in the afternoon?! Owen, turn both ovens up to baking heat this second!
Both switches on! How fast can four berry almond cakes bake AND cool, Tessa?
Forty minutes in the oven, thirty minutes to cool, ten minutes for warm honey glaze!
That brings us to twenty-five past two — with thirty-five minutes to spare!
I will grease all four round tins with butter while you whisk the eggs, Tessa!
Hannah, rinse those four bowls of fresh summer berries and pat them dry with linen!
Rinsing fast and gentle! Thank goodness we tested all three glazes on Sunday!
Imagine serving Batch One brass polish or Batch Two roof tiles at three today!
Less joking and faster whisking, Owen — fold the ground almonds in smoothly!
Wait — hear Graham calling my name from the lobby? Something happened with the room keys!
Go save the front desk, Hannah; Owen and I own this kitchen until half past two!
Retomamos agora esse alvoroço na cozinha fala por fala.
Emergency bulletin from the station desk: our mapmaker arrives at three sharp today!
'Edição extraordinária da bilheteria da estação: nosso cartógrafo chega às três em ponto hoje!'
Three in the afternoon?! Owen, turn both ovens up to baking heat this second!
'As três da tarde?! Owen, ligue os dois fornos na temperatura de assar neste exato instante!'
Both switches on! How fast can four berry almond cakes bake AND cool, Tessa?
'Ambos os interruptores estão ligados! Em quanto tempo quatro bolos de frutas vermelhas e amêndoas podem assar E esfriar, Tessa?'
Forty minutes in the oven, thirty minutes to cool, ten minutes for warm honey glaze!
'Quarenta minutos no forno, trinta minutos para esfriar, dez minutos para a cobertura morna de mel!'
That brings us to twenty-five past two — with thirty-five minutes to spare!
'Isso nos leva às duas e vinte e cinco — com trinta e cinco minutos de folga!'
I will grease all four round tins with butter while you whisk the eggs, Tessa!
'Eu untarei as quatro fôrmas redondas enquanto você bate os ovos, Tessa!'
Hannah, rinse those four bowls of fresh summer berries and pat them dry with linen!
'Hannah, enxágue aquelas quatro tigelas de frutas vermelhas frescas e seque-as com um pano de prato dando batidinhas!'
Rinsing fast and gentle! Thank goodness we tested all three glazes on Sunday!
'Enxágue rápido e delicado a caminho! Ainda bem que testamos todas as três coberturas no domingo!'
Imagine serving Batch One brass polish or Batch Two roof tiles at three today!
'Imagine se servíssemos a primeira fornada de "lustra-latão" ou a segunda fornada de "telhas de telhado" às três de hoje!'
Less joking and faster whisking, Owen — fold the ground almonds in smoothly!
'Menos piadas e bata mais rápido, Owen — incorpore delicadamente a farinha de amêndoas!'
Wait — hear Graham calling my name from the lobby? Something happened with the room keys!
'Esperem — ouviram Graham me chamando do saguão? Aconteceu alguma coisa com as chaves dos quartos!'
Go save the front desk, Hannah; Owen and I own this kitchen until half past two!
'Corra para salvar a recepção, Hannah; Owen e eu temos esta cozinha sob controle até às duas e meia!'
Vamos ouvir toda a cena novamente em velocidade natural.
Emergency bulletin from the station desk: our mapmaker arrives at three sharp today!
Three in the afternoon?! Owen, turn both ovens up to baking heat this second!
Both switches on! How fast can four berry almond cakes bake AND cool, Tessa?
Forty minutes in the oven, thirty minutes to cool, ten minutes for warm honey glaze!
That brings us to twenty-five past two — with thirty-five minutes to spare!
I will grease all four round tins with butter while you whisk the eggs, Tessa!
Hannah, rinse those four bowls of fresh summer berries and pat them dry with linen!
Rinsing fast and gentle! Thank goodness we tested all three glazes on Sunday!
Imagine serving Batch One brass polish or Batch Two roof tiles at three today!
Less joking and faster whisking, Owen — fold the ground almonds in smoothly!
Wait — hear Graham calling my name from the lobby? Something happened with the room keys!
Go save the front desk, Hannah; Owen and I own this kitchen until half past two!
Os dois fornos ganham vida sob as mãos experientes de Tessa e Owen, enquanto Hannah volta correndo para a recepção para resolver o mistério das chaves desaparecidas. Até logo!
See you later!
